-- Articles published yesterday
SELECT 
  COUNT(*) as articles_published,
  SUM(views_count) as total_views,
  AVG(views_count) as avg_views,
  SUM(reading_time) as total_reading_time
FROM articles
WHERE published_at >= NOW() - INTERVAL '1 day'
  AND published_at < NOW()
  AND status = 'published';

-- Top performing articles (last 24 hours)
SELECT 
  id, title, slug, category, views_count, published_at
FROM articles
WHERE published_at >= NOW() - INTERVAL '1 day'
  AND status = 'published'
ORDER BY views_count DESC
LIMIT 5;

-- Newsletter subscribers growth
SELECT 
  COUNT(*) as total_subscribers,
  COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE verified = true) as verified_subscribers,
  COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE created_at >= NOW() - INTERVAL '1 day') as new_yesterday
FROM newsletter_subscribers
WHERE active = true;

-- Category performance (last 7 days)
SELECT 
  category,
  COUNT(*) as article_count,
  SUM(views_count) as total_views,
  AVG(views_count) as avg_views_per_article
FROM articles
WHERE published_at >= NOW() - INTERVAL '7 days'
  AND status = 'published'
GROUP BY category
ORDER BY total_views DESC;

-- Social media performance (last 7 days)
SELECT 
  platform,
  COUNT(*) as posts_count,
  COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE status = 'posted') as successful_posts
FROM social_media_posts
WHERE posted_at >= NOW() - INTERVAL '7 days'
GROUP BY platform;

-- AI processing stats (last 7 days)
SELECT 
  COUNT(*) as total_processed,
  COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE status = 'processed') as successful,
  COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE status = 'rejected_low_quality') as rejected,
  AVG(EXTRACT(EPOCH FROM (processed_at - created_at))) as avg_processing_time_seconds
FROM articles_queue
WHERE created_at >= NOW() - INTERVAL '7 days';
